workspace.description: The workspace the task stands in, by the slug list_workspaces answered: required with a key, and with an id the workspace that must hold the task; leave it out with an id for whichever workspace it stands in.

taskId.description: The task whose description's comments to act on, by the id list_tasks answered, or by its key, such as ACME-42, with the workspace it stands in.

page.description: One of the task's pages, by the id a mention of it or a link to it names, to read its threads instead of the description's.

status.description: Which threads to read: open or resolved.
